config.scope: one personal normal-behaviour bundle per source timeline; retrospective historical evaluation on previously examined CARE Farm A, not fresh external validation
config.data_policy: never merge different source-file clocks; each model uses only its own asset and same-file prefix train partition
config.normal_policy: status 0 plus observed required channels continuously over [t-6h,t+24h], entirely in historical train partition; train normal future ends by temporal boundary, calibration normal future ends before prediction partition
config.normal_information_assumption: retrospective historical status labels are available before deployment; annotation creation time is not provided and this cannot be proven for prospective use
config.residual_calibration: historical calibration normal rows only; per-channel median bias and max(q95-median,1 Celsius) scale, no refitting regressors on calibration
config.score: max positive normalized temperature residual, causal trailing mean of 3 consecutive available hourly points, reset on gaps; no failure labels used in score
config.threshold_policy: only historical calibration certified-normal scores; smallest observed threshold satisfying both normal duration and episode budgets, or nextafter(max,+inf) if necessary; no target-failure labels or prediction-partition values in selection
config.event_success: new observed below-to-above crossing in [failure-24h,failure); count left-censored high starts separately and report any-warning window coverage separately
config.episode_denominator: all 11 canonical faults including unavailable source models
config.model_selection: one fixed personal specification, no tuning from prediction outcomes
